card.name: Comma after a noted adverse event
card.fires_on: The comma right after a plural or event noun (such as pancreatitis, serious infections, cases) that begins an aside like "including fatal cases" or "some of which". Mostly in warnings and precautions sections.

modes.label: Adverse event then aside
modes.description: Comma after a named reaction, before "including fatal..." or "sometimes fatal".
modes.example: 5.2 Pancreatitis There have been postmarketing reports of acute pancreatitis<<,>> including fatal and non-fatal hemorrhagic

modes.label: General noun then partitive
modes.description: Comma after a plain noun, before "some of which".
modes.example: These readings<<,>> some of which are illustrated, trace historic

card.writes: It prepares the model to continue with a partitive like "some" or "most" describing a subset of the items.
